plugins.description: Senior product-marketing manager across every place a product gets discovered: Google Search Console, the App Store, Google Play, WordPress.org and real-user Core Web Vitals. Search analytics, striking-distance keywords, CTR gaps, cannibalization, store listings and conversion, App Store keywords and sales, Android vitals, on-page and whole-site audits, indexing coverage, PageSpeed, and timestamped snapshots you can diff.
